policy.configuration: H2 cutoff-v1 Regularized/Linear accepted budget AWF; identical spatial/physical data; native IMEX1 single sweep; corrected NativeElementSideV2 audit
policy.pressure_policy: one common physical mean gauge over both regional pressure fields; retain their relative offset
policy.accuracy_rationale: Allocate <=0.01% of reference U/K scales and <=0.1% of epsilon/pressure scales to finite-horizon time error; traction allocation is 0.01% of reference .16. These are fixed output-accuracy budgets, below the observed roughly 0.1% field evolution and 0.265% traction/reference discrepancy of the cutoff-refined selected case. They are not rescaled by a nearly zero W or pressure field and do not certify spatial accuracy.
policy.Richardson_policy: Only for non-negligible coherent scaling. D_c=norm(q_2dt-q_dt), D_f=norm(q_dt-q_dt/2), p=log2(D_c/D_f), fine estimate=D_f/(2^p-1), middle estimate=2^p*D_f/(2^p-1). Otherwise report differences and an inconclusive order/error estimate.
classification: consistent expected order and within budget
policy.separate_scientific_policy: Existing AcceptedAWFExploratoryWindowsV1 steady-window thresholds remain unchanged; survival, small accepted increments and a splitting-identity residual are not temporal convergence.
policy.limits: Selected Regularized model, fixed spatial representation and finite horizon only; no qualification of faithful Original long-time evolution or accumulated T=5 error. No unconditional dt/4 run.
